direct_finding: Art3 assigns marketing authorisation to Health Minister; art6 application goes to Minister on form available from Division de la Pharmacie et des Medicaments of Direction de la Sante. Root current-law route resolves to this consolidation.

direct_finding: Individual/hospital prescription import exceptions and emergency/temporary permissions are separate from ordinary art3 marketing grants. Art19 allows advertising approval by Minister or designated official.
remaining_limit: Advertising-specific designation is not marketing-authorisation signature delegation; no emergency permission counts as an ordinary sampled grant.

direct_finding: General framework permits formal written signature delegations. remaining_limit: No named deposited/validated instrument retrieved; general framework or model forms do not establish operative scope for a sampled medicines decision. Archive access may require legitimate interest; no contact sent.
